rule: Every check a folded workflow job ran is one group here (a matrix job: one group per include row); its step bodies are the original run blocks byte for byte, pinned by sha256. A new check is a new group (or a step in one), never a new workflow file.
path_filters: The dispatcher runs every pull_request and every push to main with no path filter (StegVerse-org/.github#238 model); the folded workflows' path filters are not carried, so every folded check runs at least as often as before.
